sawtooth-scenic-byway.slogan: Shoshone Idaho to Stanley Idaho · one way, about 353 km back to the start

waypoints.name: Galena Summit
waypoints.advice: 235 km in you reach Galena Summit. Nothing on this route is higher. Next is Stanley Idaho, mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: Stanley Idaho
waypoints.advice: Stanley Idaho closes the day.

sections.advice: Shoshone Idaho → Ketchum is 104 km of getting across. Ride it tidily and keep the enthusiasm for what comes after.
Ketchum → Galena Summit climbs about 2652 m in 44 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Galena Summit → Stanley Idaho drops about 2652 m over 52 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.

sawtooth-scenic-byway.provenance: CURATED FROM THE ARCHIVE: waypoints taken from the named road Sawtooth Scenic Byway. Distances between stops are great-circle with a road factor, not a routed measurement - the pipeline replaces them when it routes this line.

scenicChapters.title: Ketchum → Galena Summit
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 78 km. 2652 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall — a steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.

scenicChapters.title: Galena Summit → Stanley Idaho
scenicChapters.narrative: 2652 m come off over 92 km at around 5.1%. The road gives back what the climb took, faster than it took it. Brakes early, eyes far ahead. A descent this long asks more of concentration than of pace.

sawtooth-scenic-byway.story: A one-way ride of 353 km, Shoshone to the finish - roughly 4 h 47 in the saddle. The stops in between: Ketchum and Galena Summit. The highest point is about 2,650 m. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
